rules.title: Filesystem open with joined path
rules.message: Opening paths built from variables can enable path traversal / LFI.
rules.fix: Resolve under a fixed root and reject .. segments; use allowlists.

rules.title: send_file / sendFile with variable path
rules.message: File download helpers with variable paths are common traversal sinks.
rules.fix: Map IDs to stored filenames; never pass raw user paths.

rules.title: PHP include/require with variable
rules.message: Dynamic includes enable LFI and often RCE via wrappers.
rules.fix: Use a strict allowlist of files; never include user input.
